simple.meaning: מְצוֹלָה (mᵉtsôwlâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a deep place (of water or mud).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 11 times across Exodus, Nehemiah, Job, Psalms, Jonah, and 2 more, beginning at Exodus 15:5. Its contexts include blood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְצוֹלָה (H4688).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מְצוֹלָה (mᵉtsôwlâh) / H4688 is traced through Exodus 15:5, Nehemiah 9:11, Job 41:23, Psalms 68:23 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: a deep place (of water or mud)
definitions.full: H4688. metsolah [ מְצוֺלָה ], מְצוּלָה noun feminine depth, deep ; — absolute מְצוּלָה Job 41:23 +; plural absolute מְצוֺלֹת Exod 15:5 ; Neh 9:11 , מְצֹלוֺת Psa 88:7 ; construct מְצוּלוֺת Zech 10:11 , מְצֻלוֺת Micah 7:19 ; Psa 68:23 ; — depth , plural ׳מ יָם depths of the sea Micah 7:19 ; Psa 68:23 ; absolute Exod 15:5 (of Red Sea) Neh 9:11 ( id. ); figurative of deep distress Psa 88:7 (|| תַּחְתִיּוֺת בּוֺר ); ׳מ יְאֹר Zech 10:11 (i.e. of Nile); singular = the deep sea, deep , Psa 107:24 ; Jonah 2:4 ; Job 41:23 (in hyperbolic description of crocodile); depth of marsh, swamp, מ ׳בִּיוֵן Psa 69:3 in mire of (the) depth , figurative of distress (|| מַעֲמַקֵּימַֿיִם ), compare ׳מ alone 69:16 (|| בְּאֵר ).
definitions.rootNote: or מְצֹלָה ; also מְצוּלָה ; or מְצֻלָה ; from the same as 6683 ;
